item.title: Book review: Crossing the Line by Kareem Rosser
item.description: Kareem Rosser is an author, finance professional, and polo player who captained the first all-Black team to win the National Interscholastic Polo Championship in 2011. Growing up in an underserved neighborhood of West Philadelphia, he escaped the cycle of poverty and violence after discovering horses through the Work to Ride program.
